headline: Major trouble may come: Saudi Arabia's last spare oil pipeline has stopped
summary: Saudi Arabia's last spare oil pipeline has stopped, according to a report. Oil prices are above $100, and another wave of price increases may begin.
why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, and Saudi Arabia is the largest exporter in OPEC, so supply disruptions in its network affect world prices.
why_moved: A halt in Saudi Arabia's last spare oil pipeline cuts supply flexibility, and oil prices are already above $100 per the report.
